updates.title: CVE-2026-105590: Active Directory Certificate Services Security Feature Bypass
updates.summary: A security feature bypass vulnerability in Windows Active Directory Certificate Services allows authorized attackers to bypass certificate validation controls over a network. Admins managing PKI infrastructure should apply patches promptly to prevent certificate-based authentication bypass attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-121680: Windows NTLM Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: A spoofing vulnerability in Windows NTLM authentication has been patched across multiple Microsoft products including Office. Organizations relying on NTLM for authentication should update immediately to prevent potential identity spoofing attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-118148: Active Directory Domain Services Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An elevation of privilege vulnerability in Active Directory Domain Services was recently updated with corrected FAQs and CVSS score information. Identity admins should review the latest guidance and apply patches to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation in their directory infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96082: Windows Kerberos Denial of Service Vulnerability
updates.summary: A denial-of-service vulnerability in Windows Kerberos allows attackers to disrupt authentication services. Organizations should apply patches to maintain availability of Kerberos-based authentication and secure access to critical resources.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Extends to Non-Microsoft Cloud Apps
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP and auto-labeling capabilities now protect data in third-party platforms including Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, and AWS. This expansion enables security teams to enforce consistent data protection policies across hybrid cloud environments beyond Microsoft 365.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Administrators can now apply sensitivity labels directly to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups using the same label configuration as Microsoft 365 groups and sites. This extends governance and classification controls to identity resources, eliminating the need for separate label management.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Protection for AI Agent Interactions
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now extends inline protection to local AI agents, allowing organizations to enforce policies on prompts, files, and tool interactions. This prevents sensitive data exposure as AI agents access enterprise information and act on users' behalf.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Integration with Azure Firewall
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview extends data security controls to network traffic through Azure Firewall integration, enabling detection and protection of sensitive data in network communications. Organizations can enforce DLP policies on traffic from servers, VMs, and automated workloads to prevent unauthorized cloud app access.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope Lifecycle State Evaluation Control
updates.summary: Purview Adaptive Scopes now offer administrators explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners. This ensures policy targeting and scope membership stay aligned with organizational changes like user departures or role transitions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Apply Default SharePoint Library Labels to Data at Rest
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview now automatically applies default sensitivity labels configured on SharePoint libraries to existing files at rest. This capability closes labeling gaps and ensures consistent data protection across SharePoint without requiring manual user action.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Label Inheritance for Teams Meeting Artifacts
updates.summary: Teams meeting artifacts including recordings, transcripts, and Loop notes can now automatically inherit the sensitivity label from the meeting. This eliminates manual labeling requirements and ensures consistent protection for meeting-generated content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Alert Classification
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now enables analysts with appropriate permissions to classify alerts as True Positive, Benign (operational), or False Positive with predefined reasons. This classification capability replaces dismissal reasons and improves alert reporting and policy tuning.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Data Security Triage Agent Sensitive Data Remediation
updates.summary: The Data Security Triage Agent in Microsoft Purview DLP now supports automated remediation of sensitive data such as SSNs, passwords, and credit card numbers across thousands of SharePoint and OneDrive files. This proactive capability significantly reduces compliance risk by increasing remediated file percentages.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Improved Sensitive Information Types
updates.summary: Microsoft enhanced its out-of-the-box sensitive information types to detect sensitive data with greater precision and reliability. Administrators benefit from more accurate content scanning and reduced false positives in DLP and auto-labeling policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Recurring Classifier Refresh
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview now evolves its On-Demand Classification into recurring classification refreshes to keep existing content classification current as data and organizational context change. This automated approach reduces manual re-classification effort.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Monitors FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP now monitors sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols and can apply restrictive actions based on organizational policies. Organizations can configure these transfer activities in Endpoint DLP policies to extend data protection to legacy file transfer methods.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management Azure PST Import
updates.summary: Azure PST Import enables migration of PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes using the standard Exchange Migration Service pattern. Administrators can validate, assess, and import PST content through a streamlined analysis and execution workflow.
